meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取解析流式细胞术标准数据文件并支持生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要处理流式细胞术实验的 FCS 数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and create Flow Cytometry Standard data files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: Claude 会写 Python 代码用 FlowIO 读写 FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 文件:查看元数据与通道信息、把事件数据取成 NumPy 数组、导出 CSV,也能新建 FCS 3.1 文件。
howto.when: 当你需要解析或检查 FCS 文件、提取事件数据,或生成新的 FCS 3.1 文件时触发;补偿、门控等高级分析建议改用 FlowKit。

say.text: 帮我读取这个 FCS 文件,列出通道信息和元数据。
say.note: 只解析 TEXT 段,不加载事件数据。

say.text: 把这些 .fcs 文件的事件数据导出成 CSV。
say.note: 事件写成 DataFrame 后存为 CSV。

say.text: 把这个多数据集的 FCS 文件拆开,逐个查看。

howto.what_en: Claude writes Python with FlowIO to read FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 files: inspect metadata and channels, extract events as NumPy arrays, export CSV, and create new FCS 3.1 files.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need to parse or inspect FCS files, extract event data, or create new FCS 3.1 files. For compensation, gating, or FlowJo workspaces, FlowKit is recommended instead.

say_en.text: Read this FCS file and list its channel info and metadata.
say_en.note: Parses only the TEXT segment, skipping events.

say_en.text: Export the event data from these .fcs files to CSV.
say_en.note: Events go into a DataFrame, then a CSV.

say_en.text: Split this multi-dataset FCS file and show me each dataset.
say_en.note: Uses read_multiple_data_sets to load all datasets.
